$comment: Canonical closed vocabularies for Phase 2C v2 direct-human Calendar writes. Python, Rust, and TypeScript each assert their own allowlists equal this file. A value added to one layer and missed in another is a test failure, not a runtime 'local_state_invalid' the owner discovers. See docs/phases/PHASE_2C.md and docs/CALENDAR_BEHAVIOR.md.

storage.$comment: Exactly the CHECK-constrained vocabularies of immutable migration 0007. These may not be changed without an additive 0008+ revision.

unused_by_coordinator.$comment: Storage vocabulary the new direct-human coordinator never produces. Retained only because migration 0007 is immutable; storage vocabulary does not dictate product behavior.

coordinator.$comment: R0 product vocabularies. Narrower than storage on purpose.

recovery.$comment: The closed recovery taxonomy. Deliberately no generic member: there is no 'conflict', 'needs_review', 'apply_ion', or 'keep_google'. Every failure_class maps into exactly one kind below.
